title: Find the full names and nationalities of drivers who set a fastest lap time
question: Find the full names and nationalities of drivers who set a fastest lap time at the Austrian Grand Prix circuit and were born before 1985. Among them, return only those whose constructors are Italian, and list them in descending order of their constructor's all-time highest points.

SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039, d.XCL_041
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.XCL_034 = r.XCL_075
JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
JOIN constructors co ON r.XCL_076 = co.XCL_022
JOIN constructorStandings cs ON co.XCL_022 = cs.XCL_017
WHERE r.XCL_088 IS NOT NULL
  AND ra.XCL_069 = 'Austrian Grand Prix'
  AND d.XCL_040 < '1985-01-01'
  AND co.XCL_025 = 'Italian'
GROUP BY d.XCL_034, d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039, d.XCL_041
ORDER BY MAX(cs.XCL_018) DESC
